sources.publisher: Department of Consular Affairs, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Thailand
sources.officialityEvidence: The Thai MFA Consular Department's official schedule is dated 4 August 2026 and separates Ordinary Passport from Diplomatic/Official Passport treatment.

sources.title: Embassy of Panama: immigration and visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Panamanian Government embassy page publishes a named no-visa visitor-country list and expressly includes Thailand, separately from conditional third-country-document routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Visa Required: IF you are from any of the following countries ... Thailand

policies.title: Thai ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Thai MFA's current Ordinary Passport schedule identifies Panama as visa-free for a stay of up to 90 days.
conditions: The current Thai MFA schedule states a 90-day ordinary Thai-passport visa exemption for Panama.
Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Thai ordinary passports: current visitor visas on arrival
policies.summary: Thai MFA's current VOA schedule expressly includes ordinary Thai passports for these destinations.
conditions: The current Thai MFA schedule expressly identifies ordinary passports: Cabo Verde 30 days, Comoros 45 days, Guinea-Bissau 90 days, Jordan 30 days and Sierra Leone 30 days.
Entry point, fees, passport validity, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.
